scope: Compact authoring/review dossier plus final core calibration/selected tests and performed audio evidence and final compiled-data identity verification. Native-host CI, operating-system artifact verification and the complete agent ledger are integration-owned additions.
measurement_integrity: No measurements were recalculated. Archived text removes the checkout prefix where present; final core log additionally abbreviates the producing Python runtime executable path. Original/stored hashes record these transformations. Reproduction sources remain verbatim. New compact indexes explicitly identify selections from larger original evidence files.
limitations: Candidate parameter-override renders use the frozen baseline engine and baseline master volumes. They are not the final calibrated download.
Artifact-pipeline smoke uses the frozen baseline executable and cannot certify final CI assets.
Identity snapshot precedes later calibration and UFO Landing metadata correction; final identity review must account for both.
Character tests contain128 checks after window hardening; review/summary.json preserves the earlier116-check review snapshot.
Software behavior evidence is not acoustic-instrument equivalence, physical CS-80 calibration or a listening-panel result.
Final core integration passed four selected preset suites. Native-host, CI and download publication results are separate and are not certified by these local records.
